description: r.main registers an async finalizer and its one task finishes, but nothing closes the region: the finalizer is spawned only when the region reaches Finalizing, so it never runs, and the run ends with the finalizer still on the region's stack. Rust's is_quiescent requires every region's finalizers to be empty (RegionRecord::finalizers_empty), so the final snapshot is not quiescent although no task is live and no obligation is held.
